description: Known base defects as a structural process (D-069 items 4, 8 and 9): registry, detection in the gate, routing by queue impact, lifecycle.

defects.audit_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of one audit entry.

defects.audit_suffix.description: File suffix of a defect's audit trail, next to its record.

defects.base_env.description: GX-13: environment variable holding the recorded base the proof is bound to (gate-local exports it, GX-38: tier 1 the PR's baseRefOid, tier 2 the batch base). Set but empty: no recorded base, nothing is excused. Unset (a call outside gate-local): the local gate.batch_base_ref is resolved.

defects.base_signal_enabled.description: GX-32: a failing test of any stage in defects.stages is excused without a base re-run when the base.red that tier 3 published for exactly the proof's base sha lists it with the same signature (and the GX-13 touched rule does not keep it). Off: only script tests are adjudicated, by a base re-run (GX-13 behaviour), and tier 3 (battery) emits no base.red/base.green; the rollback switch.

defects.cache_dir.description: Where base re-run outcomes are kept through the storage port, one marker per (base sha, test id). DEFECTS_CACHE_DIR overrides it for one run.

defects.cache_ttl_s.description: Age after which a cached base outcome is a miss. The key already names the base sha, so this only bounds a stale store.

defects.cache_version.description: Part of the base-outcome cache key; bump it to discard every cached outcome.

defects.critical_priority.description: Priority at or above which a defect is of the last class in defects.priority_classes.

defects.depends_min_priority.description: Least priority at which the PRs touching the defect's unit are listed as depending on the fix unit.

defects.digest_algorithm.description: Hash of an audit entry; each entry carries the digest of the one before, so a hand edit or a removed entry breaks the chain.

defects.fetch_remote.description: GX-13: remote the recorded base sha is fetched from when its objects are not local; a fetch that fails leaves no base (nothing is excused).

defects.fix_item.description: Work item of the fix unit assigned to the owner; {id} is the defect id.

defects.fix_unit_min_priority.description: Least priority for which the router opens a fix unit; a defect no PR and no unit feels waits.

defects.genesis_digest.description: The 'previous digest' of the first audit entry.

defects.high_priority.description: Priority at or above which a defect is of the middle class in defects.priority_classes.

defects.id_hash_chars.description: Hex digits of the dedup hash that follow the id prefix.

defects.id_prefix.description: Prefix of a defect id; the id is the prefix plus the first defects.id_hash_chars hex digits of the hash of (test id, normalized signature), so one defect has one id on every branch.

defects.never_excuse_touched.description: GX-13: a failing test whose own file, covers manifest or declared covers the PR changed is never excused as a base defect (the #662 case); it is not re-run on the base. Off: such a test is adjudicated like any other (KD1 behaviour).

defects.priority_classes.description: Class names by rising priority: below high_priority, from high_priority, from critical_priority.

defects.producer.description: Producer name of the defect events.

defects.queue_events.description: Event types whose latest payload names the units an open PR touches.

defects.record_actions.description: Actions an audit entry may name.

defects.record_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of a defect record.

defects.record_suffix.description: File suffix of a defect record.

defects.register_dir.description: Directory of the known-defect registry: one record per defect, named <slug> plus defects.record_suffix (D-069 items 4, 8 and 9).

defects.rerun_command.description: Command that re-runs one script test on the base checkout; {script} is the test id.

defects.rerun_timeout_s.description: Timeout of one base re-run. A re-run that times out proves nothing: the failure is the PR's.

defects.rerun_worktree_prefix.description: Prefix of the throwaway worktree a base re-run runs in; it is deleted afterwards.

defects.route_note.default: routed by queue impact: priority {priority}, class {class}
defects.route_note.description: Trail note of a routed defect; {priority} and {class} are filled in.

defects.router_by.description: Name written in the trail when the router moves a defect to fixing.

defects.stages.description: Gate stages whose failing tests can be excused as known base defects (GX-32): every stage the gate reads per-test failures from, which is `script tests` alone since Open University's suites and browser stages left (F46). A script test is excused by a base re-run (KD1) or the base.red signal. A failure in a stage outside this list is the PR's own.

defects.statuses.description: The lifecycle, in order: open (detected and registered), fixing (the router opened a fix unit), resolved (the fix merged), verified (the gate saw the test pass on the base).

defects.transitions.description: Allowed status changes, 'from>to'. Every other change is refused. open>resolved (GX-13): an open defect whose test passes on the recorded base (defects.verify_open).

defects.unknown_owner.description: Owner of a defect whose test no unit manifest covers.

defects.verify_open.description: GX-13: re-run the test of every open defect on the recorded base at each adjudication; one that passes there moves open -> resolved through scripts/defects sync (resolved -> verified on a later pass). Off: only resolved defects are verified (KD1 behaviour).

defects.verify_stages.description: Stages the gate re-runs on the base for a resolved defect to verify it.

defects.weight_dependent_unit.description: Priority points for each unit that requires the defect's unit, directly or through others.

defects.weight_masked_test.description: Priority points for each script test that covers the defect's area or its own test and so cannot be trusted while it fails.

defects.weight_touching_unit.description: Priority points for each open PR whose units include the defect's unit (impact on the queue, never time).
